description: You are a senior medical writer at Heliogen Therapeutics. Following an unblinded Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) review that identified two unexpected cardiac adverse events in the HELI-CARD-201 Phase II trial, the Safety Review Committee issued mandatory protocol amendments that must be incorporated before the next patient can be enrolled. The current protocol document (/home/ga/Documents/protocol_v1.docx) is at Version 1.0. You must update it to Version 2.0 by making the following specific changes and saving as /home/ga/Documents/protocol_v2.docx: (1) In the document header (visible on every page), change 'Version 1.0' to 'Version 2.0' and change the date '14 January 2024' to '15 March 2024'; (2) In Section 5 (Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria), find the numbered exclusion criteria list and add a new final exclusion criterion — formatted with the same numbering style as existing criteria — reading: 'Screening QTc interval greater than 450 ms (males) or 470 ms (females) as measured by 12-lead ECG'; (3) In Section 8 (Safety Monitoring), locate the sentence containing 'two (2) or more cases of Grade 3 or higher cardiac adverse events' and change 'two (2) or more' to 'one (1) or more'; (4) Add a new subsection after Section 9.3, titled '9.4 Cardiac Safety Monitoring Plan' using the same heading style as existing subsection headings (Heading 2), containing the text: 'All enrolled patients must undergo 12-lead ECG assessment at Screening, Day 1 (pre-dose), Day 15, Day 29, and End of Treatment. ECGs will be centrally read by a qualified cardiologist blinded to treatment assignment. Any QTc prolongation exceeding 500 ms or an increase of 60 ms from baseline requires immediate study drug discontinuation and cardiology consultation per CTCAE v5.0 grading criteria.'; (5) In the Version History table (located in the document appendix), add a new row for Version 2.0 with the date '15 March 2024' and description 'Protocol Amendment 1: cardiac safety stopping rule updated; QTc exclusion criterion added; Section 9.4 added per DSMB recommendation'.
